MoreBees standalone-Pi installer v2.0.0

  sudo bash installers/standalone/install_standalone.sh [flags]

Flags:
  --only <k[,k...]>    run only these phases (allow-list, wins over --skip-phase)
  --skip-phase <k>     skip a phase (repeatable)
  --dry-run            print the plan and exit, changing nothing
  --verbose            stream command output instead of the spinner
  --non-interactive    never prompt; take defaults
  --help               this text

Phases:
  10   System Dependencies
  15   GUI Fonts
  20   MCC DAQ HAT Library
  30   Release Checkout
  40   Python Environment
  50   Desktop Integration
  55   CLI Wrappers
  60   Data Directory
  70   Blue-Green Update Layout
  80   Deploy Key
  90   Hardware Setup

Env: RSO_GIT_REF=vX.Y.Z (release to install), RSO_ALLOW_REPROVISION=1
     (override the already-provisioned refusal), MB_VERBOSE=1, MB_UI=plain
